status: Accepted OMF Kind descriptor/lookup/unavailable/retention rules. Duration and remaining OMF fields under review.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Kind rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read Duration from OMF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Accepts preceding proposed qualified-own-descriptor OMF Kind mapping including the existing contextual WAVE compatibility branch, unknown/independence policy, compact typed result and no additional read merely for Kind. Begins OMF Duration research. No runtime implementation/cutover, MDB lookup expansion, Bin Filter change, final source priority or new header-opening trigger.

agreedBellaRules.scope: Kind only inside an already-read supported OMF. Existing release-one version/identity/text decisions, MDB six-class lookup and Bin Filter unchanged. Native WAV/AIFF precedence, final source priorities and header opening remain separate.
agreedBellaRules.authority: Safely resolved own descriptor of the class-qualified physical file owner, using established full-ID ownership. No selected-master-track vote or raw MediaData-class shortcut.
agreedBellaRules.audioCompatibility: Preserve existing WAVE only in the checked own descriptor slot. No genuine WAVE-as-descriptor fixture was verified; this retains current compatibility behavior, not newly proven native/standard coverage. A root WAVE data object alone is insufficient.
agreedBellaRules.unavailable: Missing/unreadable/unsupported class, unsafe ownership or contradictory required class/owner facts gives no OMF Kind. Preserve inventory and independent valid metadata; unrelated damaged numeric/codec fields do not erase a known independently valid class. Display lowercase unknown if no eligible source supplies Kind.
agreedBellaRules.representation: Four-byte structured class tags need no UTF8/MacRoman conversion. One small fixed C++17 helper returns a strongly typed Audio/Video/Unknown value. Generate display text as needed; no per-row duplicate class string or hierarchy solely for Kind.
agreedBellaRules.reading: Do not read codec/summary/recording data or master track graph merely to confirm a known own descriptor. No extra file open approved here.
agreedBellaRules.noScopeExpansion: No generic DIDD or new aliases added merely from native inheritance. Preserve current JPED/TIFD OMF coverage rather than narrowing to MDB list.
agreedBellaRules.engineeringAssessment: Current Kind already uses a small lookup. No demonstrated Kind-specific speed or accuracy improvement. Whole Bella design requires required-output, scan-time and peak-memory comparisons after implementation.
